codes.title: Patch touched out-of-scope paths
codes.condition: Any changed path is outside allowlist: ai/ai-change-gates/** plus configured SSOT path
codes.min_fix: Revert out-of-scope files; keep only ai/ai-change-gates/** and SSOT markdown updates; rerun gatecheck.

codes.title: Run record validation failed
codes.condition: last_run json missing required fields or wrong types
codes.min_fix: Regenerate run record via run_record.sh and ensure required fields: run_id/timestamp/inputs/outputs/roles/verifier/latency_ms/next_actions.

codes.title: Too many next actions
codes.condition: next_actions length is greater than 3 in SSOT or run record
codes.min_fix: Trim next_actions to max 3 prioritized items and rerun gatecheck.

codes.title: Open assumption without closure fields
codes.condition: Any SSOT assumption is Open or missing owner/deadline
codes.min_fix: For each open assumption set owner+deadline, or close it with evidence and rationale.

codes.title: Action lacks evidence/verification plan
codes.condition: Any next_actions item misses produces/evidence/verification field
codes.min_fix: Add produces/evidence/verification plan for each action (command + artifact target).

codes.title: SSOT last_run is missing or stale
codes.condition: SSOT lacks last_run, points outside runs/, points to missing file, or not latest run json

codes.title: Schema/contract invalid
codes.condition: SSOT required keys or contract json/template files are missing/invalid
codes.min_fix: Fix missing keys/files and JSON parse errors, then rerun gatecheck.

codes.title: Risk marker without mitigation
codes.condition: Risk signal exists but mitigation text is absent
codes.min_fix: Add explicit mitigation owner+plan for each risk marker.

codes.title: Review pack files missing
codes.condition: review.md or findings.yaml is missing or empty under artifacts dir
codes.min_fix: Regenerate review pack and ensure review.md/findings.yaml are created with non-empty content.

codes.title: changed_files.txt empty while diff.patch has content
codes.condition: diff.patch is non-empty but changed_files.txt is missing or has zero non-blank lines
codes.min_fix: Validate BASE/HEAD exist in current repo/worktree, then regenerate changed_files via: git diff --name-only "$BASE..$HEAD" > <artifacts_dir>/changed_files.txt and rerun strict review.

codes.title: Review pack missing 3-layer review structure
codes.condition: review.md does not contain required layers (summary/strategy/findings)
codes.min_fix: Regenerate review.md with 3 layers: layer1 summary, layer2 review strategy, layer3 findings.

codes.title: findings.yaml schema invalid
codes.condition: Any finding is missing required keys: id,fingerprint,status,must_fix,locations,closure
codes.min_fix: Normalize findings.yaml so every finding has required keys and valid values.

codes.title: Open must-fix findings exist
codes.condition: At least one finding has must_fix=true and status=open
codes.min_fix: Fix or explicitly close all open must-fix findings, then rerun strict review + gatecheck.
